rules.voice_source: The approved brand_voice answer in the locked Skill 50 brief, rendered for SMS; one voice across the whole launch, matching the emails.
rules.a2p_gate: When a2p_ready=false, every text stays a draft and the package warns: texts cannot send until A2P 10DLC is approved.
rules.character_counting: 160 GSM-7 characters per segment, 320 = 2 segments; non-GSM characters force UCS-2 at 70 per segment, so keep curly quotes, em dashes and emoji out unless the approved brand_voice requires them.

send_window.outside_window_policy: clamp to the next window start; drop the text if the clamped time lands after the event it refers to

optin_confirm.voice_intent: Confirm the sign-up, say exactly what arrives and when, and ask one easy question so a reply is natural. No offer pitch.

keyword_optin.voice_intent: Confirm the keyword worked and deliver the thing it promised. The confirmation is the reply invitation; never bait another keyword.

reminder_1d.voice_intent: Plain time-and-place reminder, one link, one warm line. No new offer claims.

reminder_1h.voice_intent: Short, calm, specific to the hour. One link, one reply invitation.

reminder_15m.voice_intent: Two sentences at most. Time, link, reply invitation. Nothing else.

doors_open.voice_intent: Say the doors are open, name the offer once, use only the approved deadline. One link, reply invitation.

last_call.voice_intent: Truthful deadline only, stated once. No invented scarcity, no countdown theatre. One link, reply invitation.

abandoned_checkout.voice_intent: Neutral, no blame: the checkout did not finish, the cart is still open. One resume link, reply invitation. Stops on purchase.

access_link.voice_intent: Deliver access or receipt first, then the single next step. One link, reply invitation. Never mixes in a sales pitch.

forbidden: persona names, quotes or book references (Skill 50 AF-EMAIL-PERSONA-NAMED rule carries over)
invented deadlines, fake scarcity or countdowns not in the approved offer
prices or bonuses that are not in the approved offer version
ALL CAPS shouting beyond STOP and the reply keyword
emoji unless the approved brand_voice sample uses them
the word unsubscribe; SMS opt-out is STOP only
sending, scheduling against a live account, or any state change while draft_only is true

examples.text:
Doors are open, {first_name}. {offer_name} is live now, and the launch price holds until {deadline}. Take a look: {link}
Reply YES and I'll send the details. Reply STOP to opt out.

We start in 1 hour, {first_name}. Join here: {link}
Reply YES if you want the replay link instead. Reply STOP to opt out.

Looks like your checkout did not finish, {first_name}. Your cart is still open: {link}
Reply YES and I'll resend the link. Reply STOP to opt out.

You're in, {first_name}. Here is your access: {link}
Reply YES and I'll send the receipt and next steps. Reply STOP to opt out.
